One critical indirect mechanism that exists to ensure smooth labor transitions is the unemployment insurance program.

Finding new, high-quality jobs for displaced workers may take time, and a flexible unemployment insurance system allows workers to search for higher-paying and better jobs (Chetty 2008 ; Schmieder, von Wachter, and Bender 2012; Nekoei and Weber 2017 ).
